notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list the Fallon Cantaloupe Festival for Aug. 28-30, chamber number 775-423-2544, and mark 775-816-8474 as no good. Current official festival information confirms the 2026 event Aug. 28-30 and lists info@falloncantaloupefestival.com with 775-427-4250. Source: handwritten call notes, page 81; current official festival website check.
